answer_key.summary: Yes, potentially. Under LCD L33822 a CGM is covered for a beneficiary with diabetes who is either treated with insulin OR has a history of problematic hypoglycemia (recurrent level 2 or at least one level 3 event) despite attempts to modify treatment, plus practitioner visit and documentation requirements. A non-insulin patient qualifies only through the hypoglycemia pathway.
